brief.headline: Push UFLEX from ₹385.00/KG to ₹250.00/KG (the Silk Polypack price) — that saves us ₹22718 a year and matches the open market's fair band of ₹205–305/kg.

priceAsk.summary: Ask UFLEX to match ₹250.00/KG — the price Silk Polypack gives us for the same laminate.
priceAsk.target: ₹250.00/KG (down from ₹385.00/KG) — closes a 54.0% gap and saves ₹22718 per year
priceAsk.basis: Silk Polypack already supplies us at ₹250.00/KG. The open-market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate sits at ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), so our best price is market-fair. UFLEX's ₹385.00/KG is 54.0% above that and costs us an extra ₹22718 every year.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 60 days to 30 days after receipt.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Frees up ₹5325 in cash for us.

brief.financialLeverage: UFLEX publishes no financials, so we can't see how tight their cash is or how big a customer we are to them. But our own numbers are clear: we're paying 54.0% more than Silk Polypack, and the open market confirms ₹250/kg is fair. That gap — and the fact we have Huhtamaki and Constantia Parikh lined up as proven second sources — means we can push hard on price and faster payment without worrying we'll lose supply.

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter, already a tiny FDC supplier — a proven, scalable second source for laminate sachets.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter with pharma blister/sachet laminates — strong second-source; revenue ₹222.04 Cr, health D (31/100).

risks: UFLEX's financials aren't public, so we can't confirm how stable they are — line up Huhtamaki or Constantia Parikh before pushing too hard.
Our spend with UFLEX is only ₹64788 per year — they may not prioritise a small buyer's price ask unless we signal volume growth or a second-source RFQ.
Silk Polypack at ₹250.00/KG is our only internal benchmark; if they stumble, we need Huhtamaki or Constantia qualified fast.
UFLEX is both a film-maker and converter — they may resist matching a pure converter's price (Silk Polypack); benchmark their film cost against Ester or Jindal and their conversion margin separately.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying you ₹385 a kilo when Silk Polypack gives us ₹250 for the same laminate and the open market sits at ₹205–305 — let's talk about how we close that 54.0% gap and move to 30-day payment.
